newsitem.title: USA: Cherry Q4 helped by improved production.
newsitem.headline: Cherry Q4 helped by improved production.

text.p: Cherry Corp said earnings for the February 28 fourth quarter, $0.32 per share compared to $0.19 in 1996, benefited from improved manufacturing execution and the reduction of costs associated with new product introductions.
Sales for the quarter were $108.8 million, or one percent below the year-ago period because of foreign currencies, which account for more than 35 percent of the company's total revenues.
Because of strengthening of the U.S. dollar, the company's revenues were reduced by about $5 million.

Chairman Peter Cherry, in a statement, said among new products being developed by Cherry are a line of sensors and proprietary power management integrated circuits for the computer and telecommunications markets.
